title: Pipeline design corrections: image pages, one review pass, statement-page selection
points: Useful image-heavy pages are now routed to ReOCR/vision instead of being silently dropped — the page tagger decides whether an `img.jpg` page has statement, remuneration, multi-year, or other useful cues.
The page-review stage is being consolidated into a single pass per page: summary, tags, and repair/image flags from one call, so input tokens are never paid twice for the same page.

Deterministic gates only remove pages we are certain are useless, corrupt, blank, or out of scope; exact statement pages remain a model-assisted `statement_pages` manifest built from tagged candidates and nearby context.
These corrections are recorded in the pipeline spec and this public changelog so the implemented design stays auditable.

keystones.name: useful image pages routed to ReOCR/vision instead of dropped
deterministic gates exclude only certain useless/corrupt pages
statement_pages locator owns exact statement-page map
one review pass per page (summary + tags + flags in one call)
